hypotheses.P1_direct_rank1_assignment: The direct MLP-write class effect has a globally best rank-1 diagonal assignment with exact p at most 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P2_direct_rank4_assignment: The direct MLP-write class effect has a globally best rank-4 diagonal assignment with exact p at most 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P3_direct_improves_final: Direct-write assignment p is smaller than end-to-end assignment p at both ranks on every corpus.
hypotheses.P4_direct_row_specificity: At the better direct rank, own-category modes are row maxima for at least four eligible targets on every corpus.
